# Unreadable sourcestamp input reaches the corrupt-file guard with a defined empty list

The fallback catches OSError and assigns lines=[] before the existing line-count warning/return. The same landing removes comm's obsolete source-stamp generator and Make override. This prevents an undefined local list on that caught path; it is not complete corrupt-input validation or proof of upstream generated stamps. The exact earlier accepted fallback proof is reused with its original time.

Scope: Source-stamp fallback cleanup.
